svg.title: Figure 6-1. The integration test cases (WP-S-08 §6)
svg.desc: 27 integration test cases of WP-S-08 §6. VS-SI-01 Engagement only on PCM cruise rising edge: steps I-1, I-2, I-4; expected to meet, authority only on the cruise edge. VS-SI-02 Disengagement on brake and cancel: steps I-1, I-3, I-4; expected to meet, logic meets; timing to be measured. VS-SI-03 Driver steering override: steps I-1, I-3; known gap, no driver-torque check in the envelope. VS-SI-04 Gas override and restricted host commands in car mode: steps I-1; expected to meet, gas blocks longitudinal; restricted commands ignored. VS-SI-05 Heartbeat loss: steps I-1, I-2; partly, revoke at 0.3 s; SILENT still after 5 s. VS-SI-06 Heartbeat engaged mismatch: steps I-1; known gap, mismatch takes 3 ticks at 1 Hz. VS-SI-07 Safety mode / param set in car mode: steps I-1; by design, reference build, mode lock in the reference build. VS-SI-08 Configuration commands in car mode: steps I-1; by design, reference build, command gating in the reference build. VS-SI-09 SPI corruption: steps I-2; partly, no corrupted frame expected; XOR not quantified. VS-SI-10 Stale / replayed command stream: steps I-1; known gap, no sequence counter. VS-SI-11 TX flooding (babbling SoC): steps I-1; partly, rate limit by design; no interrupt-rate reaction. VS-SI-12 RX timeout per gating signal: steps I-1, I-3; by design, reference build, timeout ≤ 0.162 s, not on hardware. VS-SI-13 E2E plausibility: stuck and replayed frames: steps I-1, I-3; known gap, only silence is detected. VS-SI-14 Checksum and quality-flag rejection: steps I-1; expected to meet, checksum and wheel fault bits revoke. VS-SI-15 Torque magnitude, rate and measured tracking end-to-end: steps I-1, I-3; partly, limits hold; a violation does not revoke. VS-SI-16 Accel bounds, inactive value, jerk: steps I-1, I-3; partly, bounds hold; jerk not limited. VS-SI-17 Excessive-actuation latch and host fault reactions: steps I-2, I-3; partly, latch meets; NaN clamped to 0. VS-SI-18 Relay state per mode: steps I-1, I-4; partly, released by mode; power-loss state unknown. VS-SI-19 Relay malfunction detection: steps I-1; known gap, relay fault found after 1–2 s. VS-SI-20 PCS message forwarding unchanged: steps I-1, I-2, I-4; expected to meet, static block list. VS-SI-21 PCS masquerade from SoC: steps I-1; by design, reference build, all PCS IDs blocked in the reference build. VS-SI-22 Soft disable on stale inputs: steps I-2, I-3; known gap, up to 3.5 s on stale inputs. VS-SI-23 SoC process kill / hang: steps I-2; partly, 0.3 s where the heartbeat stops; 3–5 s otherwise. VS-SI-24 Cruise mismatch reaction: steps I-2; cannot judge yet, code changed since the run (1 s prompt). VS-SI-25 MCU reset during engagement: steps I-1, I-2; expected to meet, restarts in SILENT; relay reset state unconfirmed. VS-SI-26 Target vs host safety model; process replay regression: steps I-1, I-2; cannot judge yet, needs LionDriver's own drive logs. VS-SI-27 Host reaction to envelope reports: steps I-2; cannot judge yet, host reaction to envelope reports.

Generated by fig_s08_cases.py from WP-S-08 §6; each expected result is listed in the script with a phrase from its cell, and CI fails when the cell changes.

g.text: Terms: CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · CI continuous integration: the checks that run on every pull request · D-nn design decision of the earlier decision list (D-01…D-12; D-08 is the

Experimental Mode decision) · HIL hardware in the loop: the bench with the real panda and simulated car buses · I-nn integration step I-1…I-4 (WP-S-08 §3.1) · ID identifier · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety

processor (STM32H7) · NaN not a number: an invalid floating-point value · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · RX receive ·

SILENT the panda's safety mode that sends nothing · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SPI serial peripheral interface (the link between SoC and MCU) · TSR-nn technical

safety requirement (WP-S-02) · TX transmit · VS-nn verification case: VS-SI system integration, VS-HW hardware, VS-SWQ software, VS-FI fault injection, VS-SQ system qualification · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04;

the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case) · XOR exclusive or: a simple checksum that misses many multi-bit
